name: Fee Reimbursement Scheme
benefit:
**Course group-wise maximum amount payable for fee reimbursement**

  - **In Group -1**, the maximum payable annual fee reimbursement is Rs. 50,000/- under the following course :

Degree and Master Degree Courses, M. Fil.-Ph.D., Courses of all medical therapies, Technology, Engineering, Planning, Architecture, Design, Fashion Technology, Agriculture, Animal Husbandry, Allied Sciences, Business Fin
_eligibility_text:
1. Native and under study in Uttar Pradesh.
   1. The annual income of the parents/guardians of the student is up to Rs. 2 Lakh.
   1. Students belonging to Other Backward Classes studying in all the government schools, aided and recognized educational institutes of the state, based on the Cut-Off merit of marks percentage of last year (up to the budget availability), are eligible.
